en-US.description: Enterprise Software for Complex Integration Businesses
en-US.longDescription:
D-Tools System Integrator (SI) is the industry’s most powerful platform for managing complex integration projects, from system design and engineering documentation to procurement, project execution, and financial visibility.
Built for integration firms operating at scale, SI connects your sales, engineering, project management, and operations teams within a single enterprise platform designed specifically for the electronic systems industry.
en-US.name: D-Tools System Integrator v24

zh-CN.description: 面向复杂集成业务的企业级软件
zh-CN.longDescription:
D-Tools System Integrator (SI) 是行业内功能最强大的平台，旨在管理复杂的集成项目，涵盖从系统设计和工程文档到采购、项目执行以及财务透明化的全过程。
SI 专为规模化运营的集成商打造，将您的销售、工程、项目管理和运营团队连接在一个专门为电子系统行业设计的统一企业级平台中。
